chunks: When a girl reaches nine years of age, her wealth is handed over to her, her decisions regarding her wealth become valid, and the full legal punishments are applied for her and upon her.

key_terms.الْحُدُودُ التَّامَّةُ: the full legal punishments or prescribed legal penalties

ai.seo_question: When does a girl become legally responsible for her wealth and subject to full legal accountability in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a girl who reaches nine years of age. It indicates recognition of her legal capacity over her property and the application of full legal accountability to her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: When a girl reaches nine years of age, her wealth is handed over to her, her decisions regarding her wealth become valid, and the full legal punishments are applied for her and upon her."
